message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file && grep -n "magic_load\b\|magic_load_buffers\|magic_apprentice\|apprentice_load\|file_or_fd\|magic_load_impl" src/apprentice.c | head; echo "==="; sed -n '3280,3330p' src/apprentice.c` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
I see - `load_1` opens the file with `fopen(fn, "r")` and parses it as a source magic file. So when the fuzzer calls `magic_load(magic, "/tmp/magic")`, it tries to parse `/tmp/magic` as a source magic file, not as a compiled `.mgc`. That's why it fails.

The fuzzer expects the magic file to be at `data_dir + "/magic"` and it should be a source magic file (or the compiled one needs to be named appropriately). Let me check how `magic_load` decides between compiled and source. Let me look at the `magic_load` function.
